Your capstone lives on [its own page](capstone.qmd). Everything else — course
projects, analyses you did for fun, contributions — collects here automatically.

Each project is a folder under `projects/` with an `index.qmd`. Add a folder,
re-render, and a new card shows up. Delete the example below once you have one
real project of your own.
